nativePixelSample: synthetic-wk-pixels.png was produced by real WKWebView takeSnapshotWithConfiguration and visually inspected. Native PNG limit 300000 bytes, maximum 1024x1024 pixels; total JSON limit 550000 bytes.
productionPixelLimitation: Production Rust observe always forces screenshot=false. Current public SDK cannot reliably inspect closed shadow trees, so Agent pixel delivery is unavailable. Direct native pixel fixture success is not screenshot product acceptance.
boundaries: Standalone non-installed synthetic executables; no Farfold app replacement, Agent, account, login or model call.
Observation fixture policy permits only owned http://127.0.0.1:18746; not proof of production public URL policy.
NativePreviewProbe directly reads its own test WebKit view for assertions, never exposes this test API to application or Agent.
Directory native fixture supplies synthetic bytes; filesystem allowlist, stamp and lease behavior belong to separate Rust tests.
Development pages retain network and WebSocket capability; only exact selected top-level origin is enforced.
Dispatched actions mean fixed DOM events delivered; website business success, trusted user gestures and cancellation of already delivered actions are not promised.
Mutation/nav/close/expiry reject stale future requests; a delivered effect followed by failure is unknown, never automatically retried.

NativeInteractionProbe directly passes constructed NSEvent objects to the ownership predicate; no OS key/mouse injection. It verifies installed monitor registration/removal and real pending-read cancellation, not formal-app user event delivery.

Directory progress persistence is verified across actual close/reopen of views in one synthetic process, not an installed-app process restart. Only directories use durable stores; developer services always receive a fresh temporary store.

Open shadow roots are detected and observed, but their input values are never projected. Closed-root values cannot be verified through current public SDK; pixel delivery is unavailable in every production Rust request.
reproduction: Run fixture-server.py with Python3 on 127.0.0.1:18746; clang compile NativeObservationProbe.m or NativeGuardProbe.m plus src-tauri/native/BrowserWorkspace.m, or NativePreviewProbe.m alone (includes actual production module); link AppKit/WebKit with ARC/macOS11. Outputs intentionally go to /tmp/farfold-browser-observation-probe. Synthetic tests are not installed-product or real-Agent acceptance.

cleanup.temporaryStores: Six exact synthetic UUID stores cleared after tests through native clear API; final cleanup returned fixtureStoresCleared=6, failures=0. No user/browser profile touched.
cleanup.server: Owned fixture server stopped; all temporary probe executables, diagnostic copies and native object files removed after evidence preservation.
